# KXTXR — expanded machine context

Canonical URI: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/#kxtxr
Canonical site: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/
Source repository: https://github.com/Aptymok/kxtxr
Discovery mesh: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/grimoire/discovery-mesh.json

## What KXTXR is

KXTXR is a musical and audiovisual identity organized as a longitudinal system of signal, memory, transformation and return. Public pages, campaign surfaces, archives and machine-readable files describe the same identity from different functions.

The public website is a representation layer. Canonical state is stored in explicit JSON records and versioned source files. When a fact is missing, public UI is expected to preserve the missing state rather than invent a replacement.

## Human and institutional relation

KXTXR = artist/system identity.
Edwing = human operator and performer; human authorial authority.
System Friction Institute (SFI) = external observation/provenance layer; not the artist and not a substitute for human authority.
AI = assisted composition/analysis/code/representation; not an automatic source of observed facts or autonomous authorial authority.

## Current visual representation

The current public hero alias /assets/kxtxr/que-no-07-12-hero.png resolves to the current 07/12 human primary representation, mirrored at /assets/kxtxr/que-no/07-12/ig-03.png. It is a 1080×1350 campaign asset and is constrained to a bounded foreground portrait role.

The former /assets/kxtxr/kxtxr-hero-generated.webp is 600×400 and is deprecated for hero use.

IG_1 and IG_2 are retained as MEMORY variants. Viewport-scale depth is generated by SVG vector architecture, CSS procedural atmosphere, compositing/masks, a custom WebGL fragment shader, pointer parallax, Web Audio amplitude input while REM618 plays, and a digital echo layer. A 3000×3000 QUE NO source master exists externally as art-direction provenance, but runtime does not depend on that raster.

## Interpretation rules

PUBLICATION ≠ EVIDENCE
ENGAGEMENT ≠ CAUSALITY
DISCOVERY ≠ RANKING
KRY ≠ PLATFORM ALGORITHM
AI OUTPUT ≠ AUTHORIAL AUTHORITY
SFI OBSERVATION ≠ ARTIST OWNERSHIP
MISSING REMAINS MISSING

Platform metrics may be recorded as signals, but do not independently establish artistic value, cultural causality or methodological truth.


## Operational control plane

/console/ is a noindex human-operated control and observation surface. It is not a new artist identity edge and must not be treated as public evidence merely because the route exists.

Cycle:
OBJECTIVE → CAMPAIGN → REPRESENTATION → PLATFORM_ACTION → OBSERVATION → EVIDENCE → REGIME_STATE → DECISION → RETURN

/data/control-plane.json describes real connector classes and missing configuration.
/data/regime-transition.json projects the SFI Regime Transition Program into KXTXR as an EXPERIMENTAL, uncalibrated observation contract.

Instagram/TikTok are control surfaces only when a real social connector is configured. Spotify/Apple Music/Amazon Music artist analytics may enter through bounded export summaries when direct programmatic analytics are unavailable. Raw exports remain client-side by default.

A KXTXR regime candidate is not a calibrated transition. Structured results sent to SFI remain DERIVED until the governed SFI evidence/RETURN/contrast/learning process establishes anything stronger.
